description: This Java class, EntityDatatableChecksHelper, provides helper methods for interacting with entity datatable checks via server API calls in the Fineract project. It includes methods to create, add, delete, and retrieve entity datatable checks, mainly for integration testing purposes. The class also contains deprecated methods indicating a planned migration away from direct server interactions toward a client-based approach.
